settings.title: Fewer, better
settings.text: A small range of heavyweight basics we keep improving, instead of a new trend every week.

settings.title: Made for you
settings.text: Every piece is made when you order it. No overstock, no end-of-season pile.

settings.title: One palette
settings.text: Earthy colours that all go together, so every new piece works with the ones you already own.

settings.title: Built to stay
settings.text: Pre-shrunk cotton and heavyweight fleece that keep their shape, so today's favourites are still in rotation years from now.

settings.title: Heavyweight cotton
settings.text: Dense combed cotton, pre-shrunk and garment-dyed so your tees and long sleeves keep their size, shape and colour wash after wash.
settings.focus_text: A tight knit that keeps tees from twisting or shrinking, dyed after sewing for a soft, lived-in colour.

settings.title: Brushed fleece
settings.text: Heavyweight 12–14oz cotton fleece, brushed on the inside for warmth. Used in our quarter-zips, hoodies, sweatshirts and sweatpants.
settings.focus_text: Thick cotton fleece brushed on the inside for warmth, with a smooth face that resists pilling.

settings.title: Sculpt knit
settings.text: A smooth four-way-stretch knit that holds you in and never goes see-through. Used in our flare leggings.
settings.focus_text: A smooth, buttery knit that holds you in, wicks sweat and never goes see-through.

settings.title: First access
settings.text: New drops and restocks reach members before anyone else.

settings.title: A say in what's next
settings.text: Vote on the pieces we make next.

settings.title: Member-only offers
settings.text: Offers that only go to the Collective, straight to your inbox.

settings.title: Founding members
settings.text: Join while founding membership is open and you're a Founding Member for good.
